payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies the Span-Attribute Tagging (SAT) model as the state-of-the-art tagging model used for extracting clinical concepts from provider-patient conversations.

claims.text: The state-of-the-art tagging model used is the Span-Attribute Tagging (SAT) model.
The SAT model performs inference in a hierarchical manner using a BIO scheme to identify clinically relevant spans.
The SAT model captures relevant context information using a latent representation from a bidirectional encoder.
